sn31.3:1.1: sāvatthī. atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn31.3:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn31.3:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn31.3:1.4: idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati
sn31.3:1.6: mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulāti.
sn31.3:1.8: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn31.3:1.10: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn31.3:1.11: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo
sn31.3:1.12: yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
